description: This PHP class defines the 'PayGradeCurrency' entity for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_pay_grade_currency' database table. It models the relationships between pay grades and currencies, including salary range properties.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrency
classes.description: Entity class representing the relationship between a pay grade and a currency, including salary bounds for the specific pay grade and currency.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns the pay grade ID related to this currency entry.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade entity associated with this record.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType associated with this record.

methods.name: getMinSalary
methods.description: Returns the minimum salary for this pay grade and currency.

methods.name: getMaxSalary
methods.description: Returns the maximum salary for this pay grade and currency.
